text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk into my office to find a listless
Mejiro
Ardan staring out the window.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely apologize. It's a minor thing...
Truly, a
minor thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But the other day, I went online and
ordered
volumes one and two of a book
I've been wanting
to read.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But when they arrived, I discovered that
volume
one had the original cover, while
volume two had
the modernized
redesign. They look so
mismatched on
my bookshelf...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I knew I should have taken the
time to
actually visit a bookstore and
purchase them in
person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression no brighter than before,
Mejiro
Ardan lets out a long sigh...
